mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, name, short_name, sort, bool_enabled_enum, remark, factory_id, workshop_id, user_id
mapper.select:
select id, name from mes_building_production_line where id in (select distinct t.factory_id from mes_building_team t inner join mes_building_team_user_link tu on tu.team_id = t.id where t.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tu.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tu.user_id = #{currentUserId}) and bool_delete_enum = 0
and workshop_id = #{workshopId}

SELECT line.id 'productionLineId', line.`name` 'productionLineName', ws.id 'workshopId', ws.`name` 'workshopName', fac.id 'factoryId', fac.`name` 'factoryName' FROM mes_building_production_line line LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop ws ON line.workshop_id = ws.id and ws.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory fac ON fac.id = line.factory_id and fac.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE line.bool_delete_enum = 0 and line.id = #{lineId}

select sche.workshop_id workshopId, ws.name workshopName, sche.production_line_id productionLineId, pl.name productionLineName from mes_building_artifact_scheduling sche left join mes_building_workshop ws on sche.workshop_id = ws.id and ws.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join mes_building_production_line pl on sche.production_line_id = pl.id and pl.bool_delete_enum = 0 where sche.bool_delete_enum = 0 and sche.area_id = #{areaId} group by sche.workshop_id, sche.production_line_id
